<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>斗罗大陆 · 魂师觉醒台</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Ma+Shan+Zheng&family=Noto+Serif+SC:wght@400;600;900&family=Long+Cang&family=ZCOOL+KuaiLe&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
 --ink:#eaf3ff;--dim:#9db4d0;--gold:#f0c36c;--gold2:#ffdf9e;--blue:#6cd0ff;--cyan:#8fe3d8;--purple:#b57bff;
 --panel:rgba(9,26,47,.4);--line:rgba(140,190,255,.22);--line2:rgba(240,195,108,.35);
 --rW:#eef3ff;--rY:#ffd166;--rP:#b57bff;--rB:#8fa3ff;--rR:#ff5e6c;--rO:#ff9d45;--gld:#ffd88a;
 --bk-ink:#352a4d;--bk-pink:#e63a73;--bk-pinkl:rgba(230,58,115,.15);--bk-yellow:#ffd166;
 /* ★★★ 自定义背景图：把引号里换成图片链接即可，如 --bg-url:url('https://example.com/bg.jpg')；默认 none 用夜空渐变 ★★★ */
 --bg-url:none;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:'Noto Serif SC',serif;color:var(--ink);min-height:100vh;overflow-x:hidden;line-height:1.75;
 background-color:#020710;
 background-image:var(--bg-url),radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% -5%,rgba(13,44,80,.86) 0%,rgba(4,16,31,.89) 55%,rgba(2,7,16,.93) 100%);
 background-size:cover,auto;background-position:center,center;background-repeat:no-repeat,repeat;background-attachment:fixed,fixed;}
::selection{background:rgba(240,195,108,.35)}
button,label{cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
input,textarea,select{font-family:inherit;color:var(--ink)}
body.lock{overflow:hidden}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px;height:6px}::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(140,190,255,.25);border-radius:3px}

#bgDust{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .6s}
#bgVideo{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;display:none;filter:brightness(.6) saturate(.9)}
#bgVideo.on{display:block}
#bgDust.off{opacity:0}
#dmLayer{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:40;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
.dm{position:absolute;left:100vw;white-space:nowrap;font-size:14px;color:#d5e6ff;text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.8),0 0 10px rgba(108,208,255,.4);animation:dmMove linear forwards;opacity:.9}
.dm.gold{color:var(--gold2);font-family:'Ma Shan Zheng';font-size:18px;text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(240,195,108,.8)}
@keyframes dmMove{to{transform:translateX(calc(-100vw - 100%))}}
#toast{position:fixed;top:70px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-14px);z-index:300;background:rgba(10,28,50,.95);border:1px solid var(--gold);color:var(--gold2);padding:10px 24px;border-radius:999px;font-size:13.5px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.3s;max-width:86vw;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
#toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
#fxCanvas{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:45;pointer-events:none}

/* ===== 入场玻璃 ===== */
#entryGlass{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:500;background:#040c1a;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;transition:opacity 1.4s ease-out}
#entryGlass.gone{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
#entryGlass.storm::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:#dfeaff;mix-blend-mode:screen;animation:lightning .22s 3;pointer-events:none;z-index:9}
@keyframes lightning{0%{opacity:0}40%{opacity:.55}100%{opacity:0}}
.glass-pane{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;transition:opacity .35s;
 background:
  linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 22%,rgba(255,255,255,.14) 33%,rgba(255,255,255,.03) 40%,transparent 47%,rgba(255,255,255,.10) 61%,transparent 71%),
  linear-gradient(205deg,rgba(165,205,245,.17),rgba(90,130,180,.07) 45%,rgba(175,215,250,.15)),
  radial-gradient(140% 110% at 50% 45%,rgba(115,165,220,.13),rgba(14,40,76,.34));
 box-shadow:inset 0 0 130px rgba(200,230,255,.24),inset 0 0 10px rgba(255,255,255,.4),inset 0 -60px 120px rgba(10,30,60,.5)}
.glass-pane::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.55;background-image:url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="260" height="260"><filter id="n"><feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.85" numOctaves="2" stitchTiles="stitch"/><feColorMatrix type="saturate" values="0"/></filter><rect width="260" height="260" filter="url(%23n)" opacity="0.05"/></svg>')}
.glass-pane::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(118% 105% at 50% 50%,transparent 52%,rgba(2,10,24,.62) 100%)}
.glass-pane.broken{opacity:0}
.g-title{position:absolute;top:47%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);display:flex;gap:clamp(8px,3vw,28px);z-index:5;font-family:'Ma Shan Zheng';font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(58px,13vw,122px);color:var(--gold2);text-shadow:0 0 34px rgba(240,195,108,.8),0 0 90px rgba(240,195,108,.35);pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap}
.g-title span{display:inline-block;opacity:0;filter:blur(16px);transform:translateX(-46px) scale(1.5)}
.g-title span.in{animation:gChar .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1) forwards}
@keyframes gChar{0%{opacity:0;filter:blur(16px);transform:translateX(-46px) scale(1.5)}55%{opacity:1;filter:blur(0);transform:translateX(0) scale(.96)}72%{transform:scale(1.06)}100%{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none}}
.g-title span.out{animation:gOut .5s forwards}
@keyframes gOut{to{opacity:0;filter:blur(14px);transform:scale(1.7) translateY(-30px)}}
.g-hint{position:absolute;bottom:13%;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;z-index:5;letter-spacing:7px;color:var(--dim);font-size:14px;animation:pulse 2.6s infinite;transition:opacity .3s}
.g-hint.out{opacity:0}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:.7}50%{opacity:1}}
#hammerWrap{position:absolute;top:-34%;left:50%;width:min(46vw,300px);z-index:6;transform:translate(-50%,0) rotate(-32deg);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 34px rgba(240,195,108,.55))}
#hammerWrap.fall{animation:hammerFall .86s cubic-bezier(.6,.02,1,.4) forwards}
@keyframes hammerFall{0%{top:-34%;opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,0) rotate(-64deg)}12%{opacity:1}99.9%{top:46%;transform:translate(-50%,0) rotate(-2deg);opacity:1}100%{top:46%;transform:translate(-50%,0) rotate(0);opacity:1}}
#hammerWrap.rest{animation:hammerBounce 1s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes hammerBounce{0%{top:46%;transform:translate(-50%,0) rotate(0)}25%{top:34%;transform:translate(-56%,-2%) rotate(-14deg);opacity:1}100%{top:-40%;transform:translate(-58%,0) rotate(-50deg);opacity:0}}
#hammerTail{position:absolute;top:62%;left:50%;width:70%;height:42vh;transform:translateX(-50%);background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(240,195,108,.5),rgba(255,230,150,.12) 55%,transparent);border-radius:50% 50% 0 0/28% 28% 0 0;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
#hammerWrap.fall #hammerTail{opacity:.9}
#entryFx{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:7;pointer-events:none}
#whiteFlash{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:8;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 47%,#fff,rgba(255,240,200,.85) 30%,transparent 75%);opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
#whiteFlash.boom{animation:flashK .6s ease-out}
@keyframes flashK{0%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0}}
body.shake{animation:shake .45s}
@keyframes shake{0%,100%{transform:translate(0)}15%{transform:translate(-12px,7px)}30%{transform:translate(12px,-7px)}45%{transform:translate(-9px,8px)}60%{transform:translate(9px,-8px)}80%{transform:translate(-5px,4px)}}

/* ===== 顶栏 ===== */
#topbar{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:60;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 12px;pointer-events:none}
#topbar>*{pointer-events:auto}
.brand .b-ring{width:15px;height:15px;border:2px solid var(--gold);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--gold);animation:pulse 2.6s infinite;display:block}
.tb-btns{display:flex;gap:7px}
.tbtn{background:rgba(18,40,68,.62);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink);border-radius:9px;padding:6px 9px;font-size:12.5px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;transition:.2s}
.tbtn svg{width:15px;height:15px;stroke:var(--dim);fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;transition:.2s}
.tbtn:hover{border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.tbtn.on svg{stroke:var(--gold2)}
.tbtn .dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#3d5a78;transition:.2s}
.tbtn.on .dot{background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--gold)}

/* ===== 侧栏箭头 ===== */
.side-toggle{position:fixed;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:210;width:46px;height:64px;border:none;background:rgba(20,42,72,.55);color:var(--gold2);border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 6px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.45),inset 0 0 18px rgba(240,195,108,.08);transition:left .4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),right .4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),background .25s;border:1px solid var(--line2)}
.side-toggle:hover{background:rgba(240,195,108,.22);border-color:var(--gold)}
.side-toggle svg{width:22px;height:22px;stroke:var(--gold2);fill:none;stroke-width:2.4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;transition:transform .4s;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(240,195,108,.6))}
#leftToggle{left:10px}
#rightToggle{right:10px}
#leftToggle svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}
#leftToggle.open{left:calc(min(520px,95vw) - 56px)}
#rightToggle.open{right:calc(min(520px,95vw) - 56px)}
#leftToggle.open svg{transform:rotate(0deg)}
#rightToggle.open svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.side-toggle .st-seal{position:absolute;font-family:'Ma Shan Zheng';font-size:11px;color:var(--dim);letter-spacing:1px;bottom:4px}
@media(max-width:860px){
 #leftToggle.open{left:10px}
 #rightToggle.open{right:10px}
}

/* ===== 抽屉（无标题栏 · tab 即顶栏） ===== */
#drawerMask{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:90;background:rgba(2,8,18,.5);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .35s}
#drawerMask.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.drawer{position:fixed;top:0;bottom:0;z-index:95;background:rgba(6,15,30,.6);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:transform .42s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
#leftDrawer{left:0;width:min(520px,95vw);transform:translateX(-102%);border-right:1px solid var(--line2)}
#rightDrawer{right:0;width:min(520px,95vw);transform:translateX(102%);border-left:1px solid var(--line2)}
#leftDrawer.open{transform:translateX(0)}
#rightDrawer.open{transform:translateX(0)}
.d-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)) 14px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);overflow-x:auto;flex:none}
.d-tab-btn{flex:none;width:46px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border-radius:10px;padding:6px 0 4px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:1px;transition:.2s}
.d-tab-btn b{font-family:'Ma Shan Zheng';font-weight:400;font-size:19px;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.2}
.d-tab-btn i{font-style:normal;font-size:9px;color:#5f7c9c;letter-spacing:1px}
.d-tab-btn:hover{border-color:var(--blue)}
.d-tab-btn.act{background:rgba(240,195,108,.3);border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(240,195,108,.35)}
.d-tab-btn.act b{color:var(--gold2)}.d-tab-btn.act i{color:#c7a558}
.d-body{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:16px 16px 30px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.d-pane{display:none}
.d-pane.act{display:block;animation:fadeUp .35s}
@keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}to{opacity:1}}

/* ===== 抽屉内通用 ===== */
.field{margin-bottom:13px}
.field label{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--gold2);letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:6px}
.field label em{font-style:normal;color:var(--dim);font-size:11px;margin-left:6px;letter-spacing:1px}
.field input[type=text],.field textarea{width:100%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.055);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;padding:9px 12px;font-size:14px;transition:.2s;outline:none}
.field input:focus,.field textarea:focus{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(240,195,108,.14);background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.field textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:72px}
.seg{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.seg button{flex:1;min-width:76px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--dim);border-radius:9px;padding:8px 6px;font-size:13px;transition:.2s}
.seg button:hover{border-color:var(--blue)}
.seg button.act{background:rgba(240,195,108,.16);border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold2);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(240,195,108,.25)}
.linked{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.linked .lk{flex:1;min-width:150px;background:rgba(108,208,255,.06);border:1px dashed rgba(108,208,255,.35);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px}
.linked .lk b{display:block;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--dim);letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:3px}
.linked .lk span{font-family:'Ma Shan Zheng';font-size:17px;color:var(--blue)}
.lk-note{font-size:11px;color:#5f7c9c;margin-top:10px}
.rich h4{font-family:'Ma Shan Zheng';font-size:18px;color:var(--blue);letter-spacing:2px;margin:20px 0 8px;font-weight:400}
.rich p{font-size:13.5px;color:#d6e4f5;margin:9px 0}
.rich ul{margin:4px 0 12px 20px;font-size:13px;color:#cfe0f4}
.rich li{margin:5px 0}
.rich ol{margin:4px 0 12px 20px;font-size:13px;color:#cfe0f4}
.rich b{color:var(--gold2)}

.feat-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.045);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:10px;transition:.25s}
.feat-card:hover{border-color:var(--blue)}
.feat-card.on{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(240,195,108,.22);background:rgba(240,195,108,.07)}
.fc-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px;gap:10px}
.fc-name{font-weight:600;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:1px}
.fc-desc{font-size:12px;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:8px}
.fc-cmds{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.cmd-chip{font-size:11px;color:var(--cyan);border:1px dashed rgba(143,227,216,.4);border-radius:6px;padding:3px 9px;background:none;transition:.15s}
.cmd-chip:hover{background:rgba(143,227,216,.14);border-style:solid;color:#c9fff7}
.switch{position:relative;width:42px;height:22px;flex:none}
.switch input{display:none}
.switch span{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;transition:.25s}
.switch span::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:#8fa5bd;transition:.25s}
.switch input:checked+span{background:rgba(240,195,108,.3);border-color:var(--gold)}
.switch input:checked+span::after{left:22px;background:var(--gold2);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--gold)}

.extra-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);animation:fadeUp .3s}
.ex-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:9px}
.ex-head b{font-family:'Ma Shan Zheng';font-weight:400;color:var(--gold2);letter-spacing:2px;font-size:16px}
.ex-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.ex-grid input,.ex-grid textarea{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:7px 10px;font-size:13px;width:100%;outline:none}
.ex-grid input:focus,.ex-grid textarea:focus{border-color:var(--gold)}
.ex-grid textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:64px}
.ex-full{grid-column:1/-1}
.extra-del{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,94,108,.5);background:rgba(255,94,108,.1);color:#ff9aa5;font-size:12px;line-height:1;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:.2s}
.extra-del:hover{background:rgba(255,94,108,.28)}

.pv-stat{display:flex;gap:16px;font-size:13px;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:12px}
.pv-stat b{color:var(--gold2);font-size:19px;font-family:'Ma Shan Zheng';margin-right:3px}
#previewPre{background:rgba(3,10,20,.5);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:16px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.95;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all;max-height:52vh;overflow:auto;cursor:pointer;transition:.25s}
#previewPre:hover{border-color:var(--line2)}
.pv-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:none;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 20px;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:2px;transition:.22s;font-weight:600}
.btn-gold{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(247,217,139,.82),rgba(224,168,63,.75));color:#2a1c05;box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(240,195,108,.3);border:1px solid rgba(255,235,180,.5)}
.btn-gold:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(240,195,108,.45)}
.btn-ghost{background:rgba(108,208,255,.08);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--blue);}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--blue);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-ghost.warn{border-color:var(--rR);color:#ff9aa5}

/* ===== 主内容 ===== */
main{max-width:880px;margin:0 auto;padding:70px 16px 90px;position:relative;z-index:10;opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px);transition:opacity 1.1s .1s,transform 1.1s .1s}
main.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.hero{text-align:center;padding:16px 0 4px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
.hero h1{position:relative;font-family:'Ma Shan Zheng';font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(44px,10vw,84px);letter-spacing:clamp(6px,2vw,22px);line-height:1.15;display:inline-block;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffbe9 8%,#ffe9a8 34%,#f0c36c 58%,#d19a3a 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
  filter:drop-shadow(3px 3px 0 rgba(20,10,0,.6)) drop-shadow(0 0 24px rgba(240,195,108,.42))}
.hero h1::before,.hero h1::after{content:'斗罗大陆';position:absolute;left:0;top:0;opacity:.55;pointer-events:none}
.hero h1::before{color:#8b5cff;animation:gl1 .42s steps(2) infinite;z-index:-1}
.hero h1::after{color:var(--cyan);animation:gl1 .38s steps(2) infinite reverse;z-index:-2}
@keyframes gl1{0%{transform:translate(0)}25%{transform:translate(-3px,2px)}50%{transform:translate(2px,-2px)}75%{transform:translate(-2px,-1px)}100%{transform:translate(0)}}
.ps{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 12px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.35);margin:26px 0;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
#secAwaken{background:transparent;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:none}
#secAwaken::before{display:none}
.ps::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:120px;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),transparent);opacity:.7}
.ps-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:15px 20px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;gap:12px}
.ps-head h2{font-family:'Ma Shan Zheng';font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(19px,4.4vw,25px);letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--gold2);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.ps-head h2::before{content:'';width:9px;height:9px;background:var(--gold);transform:rotate(45deg);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--gold);flex:none}
.ps-arrow{width:26px;height:26px;flex:none;transition:transform .35s}
.ps-arrow svg{width:100%;height:100%;stroke:var(--gold);fill:none;stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.ps.open .ps-arrow{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.ps-body{display:none;padding:4px 20px 22px}
.ps.open .ps-body{display:block;animation:fadeUp .4s}

/* ===== 觉醒 ===== */
.awaken-stage{position:relative;padding:18px 0 4px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:18px}
.orb-wrap{position:relative;width:min(360px,82vw);aspect-ratio:1;touch-action:none;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;-webkit-touch-callout:none;cursor:pointer}
.orb-wrap.pressing{animation:orbShiver .14s infinite}
@keyframes orbShiver{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}25%{transform:translate(.8px,-.6px)}75%{transform:translate(-.8px,.6px)}}
.charged{animation:chargedPulse .5s infinite}
@keyframes chargedPulse{0%,100%{filter:brightness(1.15)}50%{filter:brightness(1.6)}}
#orbCanvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}

      var a=(i+Math.random()*.6)/N*Math.PI*2;

      var steps=4+Math.floor(Math.random()*3);
      for(var s=1;s<=steps;s++){

        var p=pts[bi],ba=a+(Math.random()>.5?1:-1)*(.5+Math.random()*.6);

        var r=maxR*ringD[j]*(j===0?1:(1+(Math.random()-.5)*.22));
        nodes[i][j]=[c.x+Math.cos(a)*r,c.y+Math.sin(a)*r*.92];
      }

    function mkShard(pts){
      var cx=0,cy=0;
      pts.forEach(function(p){cx+=p[0];cy+=p[1]});

    for(var j2=0;j2<ringD.length-1;j2++){
      for(i=0;i<N;i++){
        var i3=(i+1)%N;
        mkShard([nodes[i][j2],nodes[i3][j2],nodes[i3][j2+1],nodes[i][j2+1]]);
      }
    }

      for(i=0;i<cracks.length;i++){

      ctx.save();

      ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.rr*p.life+.3,0,6.29); ctx.fill();
    }
    for(i=rings.length-1;i>=0;i--){
      var rg=rings[i];

    else{ run=false; ctx.clearRect(0,0,cv.width,cv.height); }
  }
  return {crack:crack,shatter:shatter};
})();

<h4>武魂</h4><ul>
<li>斗罗大陆人类在约六岁时觉醒的一种天生能力，决定了一个人是否有潜力成为魂师以及未来的发展方向。</li>
<li>武魂大致分为器武魂、兽武魂、本体武魂三大类。武魂通常由父母其中一方遗传，但也可能发生变异。</li>
<li><b>双生武魂</b>：一种极其罕见的现象，拥有者体内存在两种武魂，这提供了拥有更多魂环的可能性，但修炼难度也更大。</li>
<li><b>变异武魂</b>：指与父母武魂显著不同的武魂，可能向好的方向变异（良性变异，如马红俊的邪火凤凰净化为火凤凰、柳二龙的火龙），也可能向坏的方向变异（恶性变异，如玉小刚的罗三炮），甚至出现完全无攻击力但具备特殊能力的武魂（如唐月华的贵族圆环）。</li></ul>
<h4>魂力等级</h4><ul>
<li>衡量魂师魂力修为的标准。魂力等级从1级开始，每10级为一个大的阶段，并拥有特定的称号。</li>
<li>1-10级为魂士，11-20级为魂师，21-30级为大魂师，31-40级为魂尊，41-50级为魂宗，51-60级为魂王，61-70级为魂帝，71-80级为魂圣，81-90级为魂斗罗。达到91级以上则被称为"封号斗罗"，这是魂师的顶点，拥有属于自己的封号。</li>
<li>封号斗罗内部也存在实力差距，通常91-94级为普通封号斗罗，95-98级被称为"超级斗罗"，而99级则被称为"极限斗罗"（或绝世斗罗），是凡人的巅峰，距离神祇仅一步之遥。100级则代表成神。</li></ul>
<h4>先天魂力</h4><ul>
<li>觉醒时体内与生俱来的魂力总量，1~10级衡量（极其罕见的神级武魂可出现10级以上先天魂力，例如千仞雪先天20级），决定修炼速度与天赋。</li>
<li>先天满魂力（10级）百年难遇，如奥斯卡、唐三；双生武魂者往往也是。</li></ul>
<h4>实时魂力 · 战斗蓝条</h4><ul>
<li>释放魂技、维持领域、催动魂导器与暗器都要消耗魂力，魂力耗尽只能肉搏。</li>
<li>等级越高总量与恢复越强；食物系、辅助系可为队友回魂力。</li></ul>
<h4>魂环</h4><ul>
<li>魂师猎杀与其武魂属性相适应的魂兽后，吸收其灵魂能量形成的能量环。</li>
<li>魂环是魂师突破等级瓶颈（10级、20级等）的必需品，每吸收一个魂环，魂师就能获得一个对应的魂技，并提升自身的基础属性。</li>
<li>魂环的品质由其来源魂兽的年限决定，年限越高，魂环品质越好，提供的魂技越强，属性增幅也越大。</li>
<li>魂环的年限通过颜色区分：白色代表十年魂环，黄色代表百年魂环，紫色代表千年魂环，黑色代表万年魂环，红色代表十万年魂环（极为珍贵，通常伴随产出魂骨或魂兽献祭/重修的机会），此外还有更高级别的如百万年魂环（橙金色等）和神级魂环。</li>
<li>魂师吸收魂环需要遵循一定的规则，每个魂环位置（第一魂环、第二魂环等）都有理论上能承受的最高年限，超出承受范围强行吸收可能导致身体爆裂。</li>
<li>吸收极限会随着魂师等级的提升而增加，也可以通过强大的体魄、特殊际遇或天材地宝（如仙品药草）来突破。</li></ul>
<h4>魂骨</h4><ul>
<li>魂兽死亡后有极小几率产生的特殊骨骼，远比魂环稀有。</li>
<li>十万年魂兽死亡时必定产生魂骨（若不选择化形或献祭）。</li>
<li>魂骨可以与魂师身体的特定部位（头骨、躯干骨、左臂骨、右臂骨、左腿骨、右腿骨，共六大类）融合，融合后会极大地提升魂师的属性，并赋予一个强大的魂骨技能，该技能通常不消耗魂力或消耗极少。</li>
<li>魂骨无法被夺取（除非杀死魂师），一旦融合即为魂师自身的一部分。</li>
<li>除了常规的六块魂骨，还存在更为罕见和强大的"外附魂骨"，它可以随着魂师的成长而进化（如唐三的八蛛矛）。</li>
<li>集齐一套六块魂骨会对魂师实力产生质的飞跃。</li></ul>
<h4>魂兽</h4><ul>
<li>斗罗大陆上的生物，它们通过吸收天地精华修炼，拥有魂力。</li>
<li>魂兽的实力以其修炼的年限来衡量，如十年魂兽、百年魂兽、千年魂兽、万年魂兽、十万年魂兽，乃至更高层次的百万年魂兽。</li>
<li>魂兽达到特定的年限（如万年、十万年）时，实力会发生质变，智慧也会大幅提升。</li>
<li>十万年魂兽拥有极高的智慧，能够口吐人言，在濒死或自愿时，可以选择献祭（将自身所有力量化为魂环和魂骨给予魂师）或化形（放弃修为，重新变为人类婴儿形态开始修炼）。</li>
<li>魂兽是魂师获取魂环和魂骨的主要来源。</li></ul>

<h4>魂技</h4><ul>
<li>魂师通过吸收魂环、魂骨、自创、神赐等方式获得的能力，是魂师战斗、辅助、控制等各种能力的主要体现。</li>
<li>每个魂环提供一个魂技（十万年提供两个魂技，百万年提供四个），魂技的强弱与魂环年限直接相关。</li>
<li>武魂融合技：由两个或多个武魂契合度极高的魂师共同施展的强大技能，威力远超个人魂技（如戴沐白和朱竹清的"幽冥白虎"）。</li>

<h4>魂导器</h4><ul>
<li>利用稀有金属，通过特殊工艺制造，并能以魂力驱动的器物。</li>
<li>魂导器种类繁多，攻击、防御、储物等，最常见的是储物魂导器（如"二十四桥明月夜"），可以用来储存物品。</li></ul>
<h4>暗器</h4><ul>
<li>唐三从前世唐门带到斗罗大陆的特殊武器技艺。</li>
<li>它主要依靠精密的机械结构、特殊材质、淬毒以及使用者的手法和技巧发挥威力，对魂力的直接依赖相对较小，但魂力可以用来驱动或增强某些强大的暗器。</li>
<li>暗器种类繁多，有机括类（如诸葛神弩、佛怒唐莲）、手掷类（如阎王帖、观音泪）、下毒类等。</li>
<li>暗器以其隐蔽性、突然性和强大的穿透力、杀伤力而闻名，在战斗中往往能起到出其不意的效果，甚至能威胁到等级远高于使用者的魂师。</li></ul>

var view=0;
var farTimer=null;
function updatePageState(){
  pages.forEach(function(p,idx){
    var flipped=idx<view;
    p.classList.toggle('flipped',flipped);
    p.style.zIndex=flipped?String(200+idx):String(100-idx);
    var d=Math.abs(idx-view);
    if(d<=2){ p.classList.remove('far'); }
    if(d<=2){
      var im=p.querySelector('img[data-src]');
      if(im){ im.src=im.dataset.src; im.removeAttribute('data-src'); }
    }
  });
  clearTimeout(farTimer);
  farTimer=setTimeout(function(){
    pages.forEach(function(p,idx){ if(Math.abs(idx-view)>2) p.classList.add('far'); });
  },950);
  $('prevBtn').disabled=view<=0;
  $('nextBtn').disabled=view>=pages.length-1;
}
function goTo(v){
  if(v<0||v>=pages.length||v===view) return;
  view=v;
  SND.bookFlip();

}
